summary: Conviction Embed is an AI-native early-founder program with a live application form, but the official cohort page still lists March 20-22 retreat and May 14 demo day dates, which are past as of 2026-06-09. No current future cohort dates or deadline were found, so this should not be merged as a current event without review.

sources.title: Conviction Embed
sources.supports: Official Embed page describes the program for AI-native startups, says applications are open for the 7th cohort, lists a mandatory in-person San Francisco retreat on March 20-22, demo day on May 14, $250K investment, compute credits, rolling admissions, and class size of 10-12 companies.

sources.title: Conviction Embed Application
sources.supports: Official application form is live and requests founder, company, progress, product demo, pitch deck, fundraising, user, and revenue information.

sources.title: Conviction Partners
sources.supports: Official Conviction site identifies Conviction as an AI-native venture firm and lists Embed as a project for early-stage AI founders.

notes: Official source appears internally stale or not yet updated for a future cohort: the page says applications are open but lists dates before today's date, 2026-06-09.
No application close date, next program start date, future demo day, or timezone was found on official public pages.
Because current/future cohort timing is unclear, proposed_event is null to avoid presenting stale March/May dates as current.
